title: Interpret a held-out Bell lower bound as recoverability rather than a portable coordinate decoder
statement: A predeclared finite list of spectral resolutions uses one common-frame joint training/held-out Bell batch each. Every candidate decoder must be physical CPTP, including fallback. Held-out success gives simultaneous lower bounds ell_i<=f*(F_i)=sup_R F_e(RF_i), with bad-qualification budget sum_i[exp(-2v_i s_i^2)+eps_i+q_i]. Selection qualifies an invariant EXISTENCE property and resolution, not the old decoder frame. A fresh independently acquired future batch supplies service at that fixed source/threshold.
